1	import unittest
2	from api import update_preferences
3	from cli import clear_note
4	from settings import patch_settings
5	
6	
7	class SettingsTests(unittest.TestCase):
8	    def test_updates_note(self):
9	        original = {"note": "before", "enabled": True}
10	        result = update_preferences(original, {"note": "after"})
11	        self.assertEqual(result, {"note": "after", "enabled": True})
12	        self.assertEqual(original["note"], "before")
13	
14	    def test_explicit_falsey_values_replace_current(self):
15	        cases = {
16	            "none note": ({"note": None}, {"note": None, "enabled": True}),
17	            "empty note": ({"note": ""}, {"note": "", "enabled": True}),
18	            "disabled": ({"enabled": False}, {"note": "before", "enabled": False}),
19	        }
20	        for name, (patch, expected) in cases.items():
21	            with self.subTest(name):
22	                current = {"note": "before", "enabled": True}
23	                self.assertEqual(patch_settings(current, patch), expected)
24	
25	    def test_omitted_keys_keep_current_values(self):
26	        current = {"note": "before", "enabled": True}
27	        self.assertEqual(patch_settings(current, {}), current)
28	
29	    def test_does_not_mutate_inputs(self):
30	        current = {"note": "before", "enabled": True}
31	        patch = {"note": None, "enabled": False}
32	        result = patch_settings(current, patch)
33	        self.assertIsNot(result, current)
34	        self.assertEqual(current, {"note": "before", "enabled": True})
35	        self.assertEqual(patch, {"note": None, "enabled": False})
36	
37	    def test_update_preferences_applies_falsey_payload(self):
38	        original = {"note": "before", "enabled": True}
39	        payload = {"note": "", "enabled": False, "ignored": "x"}
40	        result = update_preferences(original, payload)
41	        self.assertEqual(result, {"note": "", "enabled": False})
42	        self.assertEqual(original, {"note": "before", "enabled": True})
43	
44	    def test_clear_note_sets_none(self):
45	        original = {"note": "before", "enabled": True}
46	        self.assertEqual(clear_note(original), {"note": None, "enabled": True})
47	        self.assertEqual(original["note"], "before")
